author: Roam55367516758

title: Nice day on the mountain
text:
Bernat guided our Montserrat hike and he was awesome — super knowledgeable about the terrain and just fun to hike with all day. Pro tip: it's a real hike, not too hard, but you're climbing a mountain so come prepared! Bernat was great about lending a hand on the trickier spots when my balance got shaky.

I really enjoyed the mix of a quick stop at the church followed by an actual workout outdoors. Highly recommend.
author: 510jimp

title: The perfect mixture of culture and hiking
text: Ramon was a wonderful guide. Taking the cable car up and then doing the hike down was a really nice way to do it.
author: StuartW430

title: Bernat -- The Best Guide We Could Have Asked For
text: Our guide, Bernart, made this visit unforgettable. He was knowledgeable, warm, and clearly passionate about the mountain's history and the monastery. He struck the perfect balance between sharing rich detail and letting us take in the views at our own pace. Highly recommend asking for him if you visit Montserrat!
author: guymB9119GI

title: Great Family Outing
text: From booking to the last moments of the trip Ramon took great care of our family. Not only did he engage the wide range of ages in our multigenerational group with interesting historical and geological information, but he also helped bring together the entire group for a memorable day. The tour exceeded my expectations.
author: ZoeAmbre
